items.source: Note: AnnotationConfigWebContextLoader supports annotated classes rather than the String-based resource locations defined by the legacy ContextLoader API. Thus, although AnnotationConfigWebContextLoader extends AbstractGenericWebContextLoader, AnnotationConfigWebContextLoader does not support any String-based methods defined by AbstractContextLoader or AbstractGenericWebContextLoader. Consequently, AnnotationConfigWebContextLoader should chiefly be considered a SmartContextLoader rather than a ContextLoader.
items.translation: 注意：AnnotationConfigWebContextLoader 支持 注解类，而不是由旧版 ContextLoader API 定义的基于 String 的资源位置。因此，尽管 AnnotationConfigWebContextLoader 扩展了 AbstractGenericWebContextLoader，但它不支持由 AbstractContextLoader 或 AbstractGenericWebContextLoader 定义的任意基于 String 的方法。因此，AnnotationConfigWebContextLoader 应主要被视为一个 SmartContextLoader，而不是一个 ContextLoader。

items.source: If the annotated classes are null or empty and AbstractContextLoader.isGenerateDefaultLocations() returns true, this SmartContextLoader will attempt to detect default configuration classes. If defaults are detected they will be set in the supplied configuration attributes. Otherwise, properties in the supplied configuration attributes will not be modified.
items.translation: 如果注解类为null或为空，且AbstractContextLoader.isGenerateDefaultLocations()返回true，则此SmartContextLoader将尝试检测默认配置类。如果检测到默认值，它们将被设置到提供的配置属性中。否则，提供的配置属性中的内容不会被修改。

items.source: Each class must represent an annotated class. An AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader is used to register the appropriate bean definitions.
